### Hope Bancorp Declares Quarterly Cash Dividend of $0.14 Per Share


October 28, 2026


LOS ANGELES--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Hope Bancorp, Inc. (the “Company”) (NASDAQ: HOPE) today announced that its Board of Directors declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.14 per common share. The dividend is payable on or about November 20, 2026, to all stockholders of record as of the close of business on November 7, 2026.


**About Hope Bancorp, Inc.**


Hope Bancorp, Inc. (NASDAQ: HOPE) is the holding company for Bank of Hope, a leading regional bank serving multicultural customers across the continental United States and Hawaii, with $19.19 billion in total assets as of September 30, 2026. Headquartered in Los Angeles, California, Bank of Hope offers a comprehensive range of commercial, corporate, and consumer banking products and services, including commercial and commercial real estate lending, SBA lending, residential mortgage and consumer lending, treasury management, foreign exchange solutions, interest rate derivatives, and international trade finance. Bank of Hope’s branch network comprises 45 full-service branches operating under the Bank of Hope banner across California, New York, New Jersey, Washington, Texas, Illinois, Alabama and Georgia, and 28 branches in Hawaii under the Territorial Savings banner; following the acquisition of MANUBANK branches on October 1, 2026, seven additional locations in California were added. Bank of Hope also operates SBA loan production offices, commercial loan production offices, and residential mortgage loan production offices throughout the United States, and a representative office in Seoul, South Korea. Bank of Hope is a California-chartered bank, and its deposits are insured by the FDIC to the extent provided by law. Bank of Hope is an Equal Opportunity Lender. For additional information, please go to[www.bankofhope.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.bankofhope.com&esheet=54630255&newsitemid=20261028950410&lan=en-US&anchor=www.bankofhope.com&index=1&md5=8369b317e166cb9fe5d73654135cc3b3) for Bank of Hope and[www.tsbhawaii.bank](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.tsbhawaii.bank&esheet=54630255&newsitemid=20261028950410&lan=en-US&anchor=www.tsbhawaii.bank&index=2&md5=ed0ba69eea35c5888723e80a0c3d1132) for Territorial Savings, a division of Bank of Hope. By including the foregoing website address links, the Company does not intend to incorporate by reference any material contained or accessible therein.
